configuration.title: VViewer
configuration.vviewer.toc.side.title: Outline panel side
configuration.vviewer.toc.side.descripti: Which side the outline panel is docked to (left / right).
configuration.vviewer.toc.defaultCollaps: Collapse the outline panel when a document is opened. Your last manual toggle takes precedence; changing this setting clears it.
configuration.vviewer.code.highlightEngi: Highlight engine for code files (tree-sitter / hljs / plain). Can be overridden per language, e.g. "[python]".
configuration.vviewer.markdown.diagramMo: How diagrams are rendered (local / kroki / off). Can be overridden per language, e.g. "[markdown]".
configuration.vviewer.diagrams.allowRemo: Allow remote diagram services (kroki / PlantUML). Off by default: the extension makes no external requests.
configuration.vviewer.markdown.externalI: Policy for images loaded from external hosts (blocked / manual / auto).
Host allowlist for external images (used when the policy is "manual").
